board.label: Baskets by department
board.keys: Tab moves from basket to basket · Enter opens the basket · Esc closes its window
board.empty: No basket is on the floor now.
board.emptyHint: A basket appears here when its order is printed and the work starts. Change a filter to see more.

window.title: Basket {code}
window.routeFailed: Its route could not be read now. Close and open the basket again.
window.readOnly: You read this basket. The production manager or the team leader moves it.
window.solvedDone: The problem is solved. The floor is told.
window.moveHint: Forward or back, to a step of its route. Back asks why. The history keeps who moved it.
window.packFirst: Pack it first: Packed at Packing makes it ready to ship.
window.backLeader: Only the production manager or the team leader moves a basket back.
window.moved: Moved. The floor sees it at once.
window.stayed: The basket stays where it is.
window.given: Given. The person sees it first.
window.printAgain: Print its card and pages again…
window.failed: It did not go. Try again.

floor.title: From the floor
floor.failed: What the floor sent could not be read now.
floor.empty: Nothing from the floor for this order yet.
floor.lateNote: The customer hears it from sales, never from the floor.

promise.title: Change the promise
promise.none: The order has no promise yet.
promise.note: The customer sees the new date and its reason. The floor's warning is then answered.
promise.readFailed: The order could not be read now. Close and try again.

error.read: The baskets could not be read now.
error.forbidden: You may not see the baskets board.
